purpose: A fresh Player must begin before materialized reality. The first accepted Player intent creates the canonical birth event; only then may the first chunk be discovered and the Player Mirror reveal the world.

boot_gate.reason: R0.5 world runtime discovers the origin chunk at boot. R0.6 must prevent that discovery from becoming canonical before birth without rewriting the frozen R0.5 generator.
boot_gate.mechanism: A local UNBORN_BOOT_SENTINEL temporarily marks origin chunk 0,0 as already seen before the R0.5 runtime boots. It carries no chronicle event and is removed before GENESIS_BIRTH is committed. The page then reloads from the born save, allowing the unchanged runtime to chronicle CHUNK_DISCOVERED after GENESIS_BIRTH.

acceptance_gates: fresh browser storage presents the unborn veil
fresh boot writes no CHUNK_DISCOVERED chronicle event before Player birth intent
accepted first intent creates GENESIS_BIRTH with deterministic seed and hash-linked event
boot sentinel is removed before the birth save is committed
reload causes CHUNK_DISCOVERED only after GENESIS_BIRTH
pending first intent is replayed into the existing command/materialization pipeline after first discovery
legacy R0.5 save opens without reset and without synthetic GENESIS_BIRTH
seal: FIRST THERE IS NO WORLD FOR THE PLAYER TO SEE. THEN A CAUSE IS ACCEPTED. ONLY AFTER THE CAUSE MAY GENESIS BECOME VISIBLE.
